VertexColors.comment:
The number_of_colors stored in the color_data must be calculated from the number of point indices
- found in the wire_indexes array in the case of a PRC_TYPE_TESS_3D_Wire
- found in the sizes_triangulated in the case of a PRC_TYPE_TESS_Face

fields.name: texture_parameters
fields.on_set1: let _ = texture_parameters.iter().map(|tp| if tp.value < 0.0f32 || tp.value > 1.0f32 { return Err(std::io::Error::from(std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData)); });
fields.on_set2: for i in 0..texture_parameters.len() { let tp = texture_parameters[i]; if tp.value.is_nan()/*tp.value < 0.0f32 || tp.value > 1.0f32*/ { return Err(std::io::Error::other("tp contains NaNs")); }}

fields.comment: point_color_array describes colors on vertices for each triangle. For each triangle vertex with point color, 5 characters are stored. The first character describe if the vertex has got RGB or RGBA components. Then 4 components are used to stored R, G, B, and alpha.

fields.name: line_attribute_array
fields.comment: line_attribute_array describe indexes in a graphic array. If a face contains multiple attributes, one index per triangle is added in line_attribute_array. Otherwise, one index per face is added, when encountering the first triangle of this face.
